activation_recipes.compatibility_policy: Do not union or intersect peak spaces silently; pin the peak-set construction and genome build.
activation_recipes.extraction: Pin an immutable source archive and checksum, preserve the cells-by-peaks support matrix, and emit a deterministic row sample plus peak-coordinate namespace digest.

activation_recipes.compatibility_policy: Keep RNA and ATAC feature spaces separate and preserve partial-modality status; donor-level alignment is not cell pairing.
activation_recipes.extraction: Pin checksums for both modality matrices and the barcode-linkage table, then emit separate support traces with a shared paired-cell identity digest.

activation_recipes.compatibility_policy: Do not collapse directed, signed, or evidence-specific relations into one unlabeled graph.
activation_recipes.extraction: Pin release and checksum, normalize identifiers without changing direction or sign, and emit one trace per preserved relation class.

activation_recipes.compatibility_policy: Preserve genomic coordinate domain and evidence class; liftover requires a separately checksummed derived artifact.
activation_recipes.extraction: Pin release/checksum and emit coordinate-domain, element-order, gene-order, and edge-support digests.

activation_recipes.compatibility_policy: Structural traces may use support only; any trajectory labels or values require provenance-preserving stage and donor splits.
activation_recipes.extraction: Pin source checksum, extract support before integration, and preserve stage/donor strata in the trace sidecar.

activation_recipes.compatibility_policy: A neighborhood graph is a derived object, not raw assay data; pin every preprocessing and graph-construction parameter.
activation_recipes.extraction: Emit the directed or symmetric adjacency exactly as constructed plus the complete derivation digest.

activation_recipes.compatibility_policy: Do not merge pathway databases or identifier namespaces without versioned remapping evidence.
activation_recipes.extraction: Pin release/checksum and emit memberships without weights unless the source defines quantitative weights.

activation_recipes.compatibility_policy: Invalid bases, tails, strand, palindrome, chunk ownership, total matches, stored records, and dropped records must be explicit.
activation_recipes.extraction: Activate only after Baseplane correctness/prepared-plan checkpoints and the Cellerator common identity ABI; compare materialized and fused paths.

activation_recipes.compatibility_policy: Structure, weights, and train/validation provenance remain separate; no cell, donor, or study leakage across splits.
activation_recipes.extraction: Persist only a structure trace and split/provenance digest; mutable learned values remain separate benchmark bindings.
